baseline_scope: Previous local bounded-streaming stage; route-only prefetch. Original unbounded-cache comparison is in terrain-prefetch-cache-validation.json.
runtime_scope: Same snapshots, two samples in before/after/after/before order, headless and Qt offscreen. Current uses world prefetch. Native terrain is unchanged; this pairs identical physical missions.

fixtures.coast45: Existing coastal Qattara mission, 45 PV carriers, 4 drones, version 12 snapshot, 240 model seconds.
fixtures.world14: Synthetic flat regional DEM, 14 complexes × 4 drones, conditional Qattara soils, 512×512 cells at 1m, 68m² PV per complex; model times 0+20s and45+30s. Generated under baseline v13 using benchmark_world_terrain --runtime-fixtures.

limits: Offscreen timings are not real desktop FPS. Two short samples do not prove speedups or long-term performance.
The reader after prepares four windows; before prepares one. More CPU and up to64MiB prepared data are intentional added work.
The generated reader changes the initial surface and is not compared as identical physics to the interpolation-only case.
The small Qt reader heartbeat excludes full map rendering, terrain setup and synchronous ground-route planning.
No 23-hour freeze reproduction; no Windows or remote CI run for this local stage. Active physics remains one bounded square.
